value: ICAR All India Entrance Examination (PG), AIQ seat
rules.quote: ICAR-Post Graduate Studies (PGS) Scholarship will be awarded on the basis of merit in the All India Entrance Examination (AIEE) in the Agricultural University.
Candidates must have obtained 60% marks or Overall Grade Point Average (OGPA) of 6.60/10.00 or 3.25/5.00 or 2.6/4.00 for General, OBC and Under Privileged States (UPS) categories
for SC/ST /Physically Challenged (PC) categories, the candidates must have obtained 55% marks or an OGPA of 5.5/10.00 or 2.75/5.00 or 2.20/4.00
Minimum age limit shall be 19 years as on the date of the examination.
600 fellowships are awarded every year based on the merit obtained through All India Entrance Examination (AIEE).
A fellow will not be allowed to avail of any other fellowship/scholarship during the tenure of fellowship of the Council.
